T-001.Title: Opened snapshot slot in diffSnapshots + record on load in store/editor.js; diffView priority chain, equal-content and no-baseline notices; locales; unit + e2e; GRACE

T-001.Note: 2026-10-19: implemented as scoped. store/diffSnapshots.js 1.1.0 gained the per-tab «opened» slot (recordOpenedSnapshot/openedSnapshot; separate map from the C-43 ring, replace-on-load, cleared with the ring by clearSnapshots/FORCE_CLOSE_TAB). editor.js records it in NEW_TAB_WITH_CONTENT (open, reopen, session restore — untitled tabs never record, focusing an already-open file keeps the original slot) and in loadChange (an external reload lands the new content; the ring still keeps the pre-reload version). diffView.vue resolves snapshot → mt_diff_baseline → opened, logs BLOCK_DIFF_BASELINE_FALLBACK instead of surfacing the backend error, exits calmly (info notice, BLOCK_DIFF_NOTHING_TO_COMPARE) on untitled/no-baseline/equal-content, and labels the header «Since you opened the file · {time}»; commands view.diff-mode untitled pre-check uses the same calm info wording. Locales: noPath/noBaseline retired, noChanges/nothingToCompare/sourceOpened added as native copy in all ten json + min.json. Unit: diff-snapshots.test.js (slot semantics + ring isolation), opened-snapshots.test.js (load-path wiring), diff-opened-baseline.test.js (priority chain + calm exits); diffView.test.js and diff-view-snapshot.test.js updated to the calm exits. E2e: tests/e2e/diff-opened-baseline.spec.ts pins corner-1/corner-2 including the swallowed-error invoke trace (chromium + the new webkit-diff project added to playwright.config.ts — one file outside ObservedWriteScope, required by R-5's chromium+webkit gate); diff-view.spec.ts raw-error test rewritten into the fallback + calm-notice pair. GRACE: graph M-011 summary (C-68 paragraph), verification V-M-011 scenario-67 + two command blocks + updated/new markers.
